description: This Java source file defines the class BackgroundSyncStream, which manages the process of detecting inconsistencies between persisted metadata and search index metadata in a background synchronization stream. It includes methods for merging, filtering, and comparing metadata entries, handling policy retrieval, and emitting index updates when discrepancies are found.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncStream
classes.description: A class responsible for merging and analyzing streams of Metadata objects representing persisted and search index data to detect inconsistencies and trigger synchronization actions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of BackgroundSyncStream with specified configuration.

methods.name: filterForInconsistencies
methods.description: Filters and emits only the Metadata entries that are inconsistent between persisted data and search index, based on comparison logic.

methods.name: isInsideToleranceWindow
methods.description: Checks if a Metadata entry's modification time is within the recent tolerance window.

methods.name: dummyMetadata
methods.description: Creates a dummy Metadata object used as initial or placeholder in merging operations.

methods.name: filterForInconsistency
methods.description: Determines if a pair of Metadata objects (persisted and indexed) are inconsistent and returns an appropriate Source.

methods.name: confirmPersistedAndNotIndexed
methods.description: Emits the persisted Metadata if it should trigger an index update, after policy validation.

methods.name: emitUnlessConsistent
methods.description: Decides whether to emit a Metadata object to trigger an index update based on revisions and policy IDs.

methods.name: retainUnlessPolicyNonexistent
methods.description: Checks if a persisted Metadata's policy exists; if not, triggers an update.

methods.name: retrievePolicyRevisionAndEmitMismatch
methods.description: Retrieves the policy revision to compare with the indexed data and emits an update if there's a mismatch.

methods.name: compareMetadata
methods.description: Compares two Metadata objects by their ThingId.

methods.name: compareThingIds
methods.description: Compares two ThingId objects according to the processing order, considering dummy IDs.
